```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r Load packages}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ineq)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(DHARMa)
library(car)
```

```{r Load data}
source("00_preprocess.R")
# TreeData now has: BA zeros → NA, outlier fix, DBH back-calculated
```

```{r Gini coefficient year 3}
gini_results_3 <- TreeData %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment, Plot_number) %>%
  summarize(
    Gini_Coefficient_year_3 = ineq(Height_year_3[!is.na(Height_year_3)], type = "Gini"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.nan(Gini_Coefficient_year_3))

gini_results_3$Treatment <- factor(gini_results_3$Treatment, levels = c("M1", "M2", "2SP", "6SP", "12SP"))

gini_summary_3 <- gini_results_3 %>%
  group_by(Site, Treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_gini = mean(Gini_Coefficient_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_gini = sd(Gini_Coefficient_year_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r Model Gini — by site}
# Site as fixed effect (4 levels), block (Plot_number) nested within Site as random
gini_model_3 <- lmer(
  Gini_Coefficient_year_3 ~ Treatment * Site + (1 | Site:Plot_number),
  data = gini_results_3
)

summary(gini_model_3)
Anova(gini_model_3, type = 3)
anova(gini_model_3)

simulationOutput3 <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = gini_model_3, plot = TRUE)
testDispersion(simulationOutput3)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput3)

# Pairwise comparisons by site
means_gini_3 <- emmeans(gini_model_3, pairwise ~ Treatment | Site, type = "response")
cld_sign_gini_3 <- as.data.frame(cld(means_gini_3$emmeans, Letters = letters,
                                      adjust = "tukey", alpha = 0.05, decreasing = TRUE))
```

```{r Plot Gini — by site}
ginibar3 <- ggplot(gini_summary_3, aes(x = Treatment, y = mean_gini, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_jitter(data = gini_results_3,
              aes(x = Treatment, y = Gini_Coefficient_year_3),
              width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_gini - sd_gini, ymax = mean_gini + sd_gini),
                width = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = cld_sign_gini_3, family = "sans", show.legend = FALSE,
            check_overlap = FALSE, size = 3, vjust = 1,
            aes(x = Treatment, y = Inf, label = .group)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("M1" = "#D55E00", "M2" = "#E69F00",
                               "2SP" = "darkseagreen2", "6SP" = "darkseagreen",
                               "12SP" = "darkolivegreen"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ Site) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Gini Coefficient of Height") +
  theme_classic()

ggsave("gini_barplot_year_3.jpeg", plot = ginibar3, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Model Gini — pooled}
gini_summary_3_pooled <- gini_results_3 %>%
```
